notes: Brand taken from the Instagram grid: light powder-blue/white carousels, deep navy headlines, navy/white rounded title ribbons on Reels covers, steel-blue secondary. Light theme: cards and backdrops are pale blue with navy type; the active caption word sits on a navy chip like her cover ribbons. 2026-10-26: user rejected the pale/icy-blue backdrop; use dark navy backdrops and cards (like the first video) with her light brand blue as the accent. Do not blur the background unless asked. Talking-only videos: captions + keyword pops (top/left/right) + zooms, no cutaways; cut retakes keeping the best take. When consecutive videos share the same set and outfit, change the caption style and pop style between them. White/light clothing: use box or chip captions; stroke-only captions get lost over it.
